origin.dylans_origin.dylans_origin.name: Peregrine Falcon
origin.dylans_origin.dylans_origin.descr: A tiny, mischievous falcon-sprite with pixie magic and breathtaking aerial speed: small, lucky, glowing, shoulder-riding, lightly armored, and much deadlier while gliding.
power.dylans_origin.dylans_origin/bite_s: You are now four times smaller with five fewer hearts.
power.dylans_origin.dylans_origin/effect: Being a being of pure fondness gives you permanent luck and a warming aura.
power.dylans_origin.dylans_origin/flying: You do not need fireworks: your magic gives you a forward and upward boost every 2 seconds.
power.dylans_origin.dylans_origin/almost: You are very tiny, which makes it hard to wear any armor apart from leather, gold, chainmail, and iron chestplates.
power.dylans_origin.dylans_origin/jockey: Press your use key while looking at another player to ride on their shoulders.
power.dylans_origin.dylans_origin/more_a: While fall-flying, you deal twice as much damage.
power.dylans_origin.dylans_origin/effect: Your pixie magic grants you a hidden luck effect.
power.dylans_origin.dylans_origin/no_fir: Your magic prevents you from using firework rockets.
power.dylans_origin.dylans_origin/pixie_: You leave a faint trail of pixie dust behind you.
Your tiny body moves with a hidden Speed II effect.
